speaker: Dallin H. Oaks
role: President of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
title: Closing Remarks
summary: President Oaks closes the conference by inviting everyone to study the talks and act on them, with the Lord's promise that whoever receives will be given more. He announces that the Salt Lake Temple will open to the public on April 5, 2027, the first time since 1893, and that a video series, Dedicate, premieres right after the session. He blesses members and their families with peace and contentment, and testifies that truth and the covenant path are found in the restored Church.
